description:
Cast Quasiduplicate by paying {1}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Specimen Collector.
When the Specimen Collector token enters the battlefield, its first ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Specimen Collector trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel and a 0/3 Crab creature token.
When the Squirrel and Crab enter the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers twice.
Resolve the Blasting Station triggers from step 2 and step 4, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the nontoken Specimen Collector.
When Specimen Collector dies, its second ability triggers, creating a token copy of the Specimen Collector token.
Repeat from step 2.
Resolve all Blasting Station abilities, dealing infinite damage to any target(s).
